TYPE 1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT
Narrative, Analysis, and Plans
1843-45 West 19th Street
From RT-4 District to RM-6 District

Ellaree Development Corp. is the “Applicant” for a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment for the subject property
located at 1843-45 West 19th Street from the RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse, and Multi-Unit District
to the RM-6 Residential Multi-Unit District in order to construct a five-story, multi-unit residential building.

The subject property is bounded by West 19th Street on the north, a three-story multi-unit residential
building on the east, a 20-foot-wide public alley on the south, and a two-story multi-unit residential building
on the west. The subject property consists of approximately 5,904 square feet of site area and is improved
with an approximately 146-year-old, single-story, single-family home that is currently vacant. The eastern
halt of the site is vacant and unimproved. The property is a transit-served location based on its proximity
within 1,320 linear feet of the Cermak Road CTA bus line corridor roadway segment and 2,640 linear feet
of the Damen CTA Pink Line Station.

The Applicant proposes to demolish the existing building to redevelop the site with a five-story, multi-unit
residential building measuring approximately 57 feet 2 inches in height and containing 16 residential units,
3 vehicular parking spaces, 16 bicycle parking spaces, and no commercial space. The FAR will be 2.2.

Floor Area and Floor Area Ratio

Lot Area: 5,904 square feet

Total Building Area: 12,540 square feet

FAR: 2.2
Number of Residential Units

Dwelling Units: 16

Efficiency Units: 0

Density (Lot Area Per Unit): 369 square feet
Vehicular Parking: 3* (transit-served location parking reduction requested)
Bicycle Parking: 16
Loading Spaces: 0
Setbacks

Front (North): 0 feet* (variation requested)

Rear (South): 5 feet* (variation requested)

Side (East): 3 feet* (variation requested)

Side (West): 4 feet 3 inches* (variation requested)
Building Height: 57 feet 2 inches

** Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, as part of this Type 1 Zoning Map
Amendment, the Applicant seeks the following optional relief: (1) an administrative adjustment for a 81.3%
parking reducing at a transit-served location to reduce the minimum required off-street parking from 16 to
3 spaces; (2) an administrative adjustment to reduce the minimum required distance between the front and
rear walls of dwelling units from 26 feet to 16 feet 5 inches; (3) a variation to reduce the minimum required
front setback from 14 feet 9 inches to 0 feet; (4) a variation to reduce the minimum required east side
setback from 5 feet 8.6 inches to 3 feet; (5) a variation to reduce the minimum required west side setback
from 5 feet 8.6 inches to 4 feet 3 inches; and (6) a variation to reduce the minimum required rear setback
from 36 feet 10.8 inches to 5 feet.
